{{Top|leg}}
The '''HY/S84 engine system''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engine system produced by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The HY/S84 featured miniaturized engine components, making room for a deployable [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacon]] that remained immobile and allowed friendly ships to jump directly to its location.
